title: Named complete party service
status: Reviewed knowledge-only operator specification; not an executable controller, native refinement proof, optimal-party result or release qualification.
use: Derive independent controllers from the game structure; do not include this artifact as shared bot implementation.
A conditional experiment may use an explicitly limited risk model. Unknown alternatives limit a benefit claim; they are not a new proof or approval gate before useful execution.
Query runtime settings and actual kit properties at use; numerical geometry below records the settled current bundle.

scope.bundle: CLI/SDK 3.0.5, engine 1.0.3 facts where explicitly qualified.
scope.clocks: Camp-first phase plus actual ordered owner turns. Record primitive input/substep timestamps separately; native input integers can advance inside one continuous owner turn.
scope.information: Personal observations and actual 8-byte team-register reads; allied vision and private VM state are not implicitly shared.
scope.guarantees: State the environment, interruption and risk premises. Neither a nearby ally nor a ready allowance is a committed future action.

group: actual remaining members and partial work
participants: individually legal work/heal/cover stations and ingress/egress
actual arrival opportunity and absolute arrival deadline
the first legal useful action each participant can deliver
intended capture occupants and actual payout recipients
each participant's compatible displaced solo continuation
personal HP, gear, held gold, bag, cooldowns, permissions and outstanding commitments
protocol: Eight-byte wrapped intents nominate a service; they do not certify current hidden HP, position, visibility, readiness, arrival or commitment.
Round-wrap aliasing and an unchanged intent do not renew observation authority.
A missed, invalidated or completed service releases/resolves the participants from actual residual state; do not retain a dead reservation forever.

requirements: Each body's travel and partial work remain individually affordable under the declared threat/support model until actual assembly.
Do not assume future helper HP, healing or damage before its timely legal action.
No implicit compulsory rally idle. Any selected wait is a priced physical prefix with an executable continuation.
A helper arriving after the clear or recipient deadline contributes no past damage, heal or protection.
Missed deadlines, refusals and interrupted observations choose a resolving action, alternate service or declared-risk continuation; Unknown is not an instruction to wait permanently.
Use fresh personally visible body HP, shield amount/timers, position, cooldowns, restrictions, M/A/C and current kit facts at the actual execution point.
Refresh actual outcomes after effects; a proposed or predicted HP value is not current physical authority.
Camp actions precede champion inputs. Use actual owner order, stuns, expiry and zero/two opposing opportunities where relevant.
Price each participant's damage prefixes and executable exit; pooled HP is not a tank policy.
Willow needs her own legal target visibility and range when she acts, not merely another participant's view.
Extra allies do not accelerate capture. Name intended occupants and verify actual recipients at payout.
Rewards split into personal wallets/bags; one body's gold cannot silently fund another body's purchase.
Include actual capture, bank/channel, purchase and recovery elapsed time for each participant.
A gold-only receipt does not require an empty gem channel, but still needs its declared investment/release continuation.
Vacate every occupied captured member footprint needed for respawn. Elapsed time alone does not establish ALIVE.
Rearm work from actual observed ALIVE/new-generation facts; preserve unknown when lifecycle authority is unavailable.
The endpoint is an observed state from which the declared next useful service can actually start.
Do not silently replace a required spawn/shop endpoint with mere field readiness, or require spawn when the declared next operator does not need it.
Retain actual partial work, receipt, bag, gear, deadline and refusal state across interruption; invalidate future authority without inventing a reset.

first_rolling_joint_version.baseline: Varg has an individually priced own exit under the declared local risk model; do not fund that exit with an unexecuted Willow heal.
first_rolling_joint_version.support: Count actual Willow healing, then make a fresh HP/shield/position quote for the next word. A legal heal on a full-HP ally is not positive HP support.
first_rolling_joint_version.vendetta: Count Vendetta only when an actual timely arrival can deliver the named useful legal action; proximity alone is not damage.
future_support: Future credit requires a named deterministic joint policy, its ordered action opportunities, recipient deadline, personal-observation premises and interruption handling.
The joint policy must represent the intervening enemy/camp opportunities admitted by its stated model.
This is a claim boundary. A limited conditional experiment does not need a universal proof against every hidden foe.

Willow: Heal range four is walking-compatible; current legal target visibility and actual cast permission still matter.
Ranged basic range three consumes M+A. A reset restores attack, not ordinary movement.
Heal and reset compete for the same successful cast allowance C.
Heal readiness does not commit Willow to heal, and nominal healing does not equal observed HP gain.
Varg: Self-shield and attack reset compete for C.
A retained shield must be priced with its actual amount, timer and phase order, not hypothetical future absorption.
Splash/area work must include every affected group's wake and the resulting per-body targeting.
Vendetta: A kill can reset cooldowns but never refreshes an already spent successful cast allowance C.
Do not schedule an additional cast merely because its cooldown became zero.
Arrival, legal target/station and usable allowances determine timely contribution.

geometry_and_cover: Willow basic range three cannot attack a wolf of range three or elk of range four from outside that camp's geometric attack footprint.
A healer within Chebyshev four of a melee body within one of a monolith is within Chebyshev five of the monolith by the triangle inequality.
These are footprint statements, not universal impossibility or guaranteed-damage claims. Awake state, actual targeting, vision and other bodies still matter.
Use deliberate actual nearest-target cover and affordable withdrawal where appropriate. Specify which body receives each ordered hit, including tie/priority effects; do not substitute pooled HP.
An action/route station being geometrically reachable or within attack range does not establish personal sight, support commitment or a safe continuation.

comparison.horizon: Compare the joint episode and compatible independent episodes at the same declared elapsed-time horizon and terminal predicate.
include: personal held currency, purchases and residual work
opponents reacting to each branch's history rather than a frozen future tape
interpretation: Actual joint labor or a successful local clear establishes contribution, not benefit over complete displaced alternatives.
Unknown/incomplete independent alternatives limit a proved opportunity benefit; they do not prohibit a scoped conditional native experiment.
Do not infer strength from summed damage, a heal opportunity, a reservation or a model win.

first_contact.coverage: Actual retained R28-55 window; no whole-game or eventual-death cause inferred from this prefix.
observations: At R33 full-HP Varg is within two of Willow; Vendetta is outside heal range four, later distance six. This supports a current kit/position opportunity, not proof that a beneficial heal was applied.
Heart gets R34 dash+basic and R35 basic before Vendetta's unrestricted owner input; one denied input is not protection through every intervening opportunity.
The selected contact snapshots are outside static harmful-camp footprints, not therefore champion-quiet.
No clear, receipt or bank occurs in this window; future party value and safe alternatives remain unproved.

first_death.coverage: Actual retained R362-379 first-own-death prefix; distinct from first contact.
observations: At R375 Willow has HP480, M/A/C ready and all three foes personally visible; the subsequent double-basic deals230, leaving250 HP.
A further115 at R376 leaves135. Recall at R377 is canceled by115 damage, leaving20; the repeated R378 recall is killed.
The prefix has no healing/NPC damage or currency/receipt/bank change.
Static NPC quiet is not a renewable recall premise under champion pressure. Nearby allies do not supply committed support.
Alternative movement/spell masks were not queried. No alternative is labelled safe and no saved private branch is claimed.

limits: These finite observations do not qualify a party controller, universal response envelope, beneficial cooperation or strength.
The separate contact-controller pilot's fuel failure is not qualified by these counterfacts.
No new match, decoder or source inspection was performed to preserve this specification.
